description:
Transport plan completeness is pull-wait-order dependent (schedule-protected path dependence). DIAGNOSIS COMPLETE 2026-07-03 (at da5b8afe8, diagnose-only pass, no code change): root cause traced precisely; fix is a scoped structural change, sketched below, not yet implemented.

THE DEFECT: canonical structural wait ordering (sorted_executable_waits, jobs/transport.rs:1034, with a Vec<String> display-render key) protects ONE schedule; the underlying contract — every plan-required position's shape recorded regardless of pull schedule — is not enforced by construction. The sort is a load-bearing inclusion-decider, violating the sorting law.

REPRO EVIDENCE (2026-07-03): dropping the sort does NOT trip the originally-named unit test anymore (compiler2_membership_operator... green 50/50 — fixture too small at current base), but the FIXTURE MATRIX reproduces the class clearly: 19 nondeterministic trial failures including 'fz2 build: compiler2 root 0 AOT compile failed: codegen: native callable value Var(3) has no settled callable boundary' (repr_seam_enum_count_after_reduce2::build), reusable-cons/reduction-count telemetry mismatches, and output divergence on reverse/quicksort/append/enum_take_drop_split (+ tail_recursion interp timeout). The matrix, not the lib suite, is this ticket's repro harness.

ROOT CAUSE (traced, not guessed): plan completeness rests on TWO GRAPHS BUILT THROUGH INDEPENDENT CHANNELS, not kept in lockstep:
(1) closure-membership discovery — solve_transport_closure / expand_transport_product_executables / expand_transport_product_incoming_producers (jobs/transport.rs:806-1096) walk CallSiteSummary targets + RuntimeDemand.callable_flows directly off world/session facts to decide which executables solve together. A position unreachable in that walk gets no shape; if its covering TransportComponent materializes shapeless, produce_transport_shape_product (jobs/transport.rs:679-695) unconditionally records TransportShapeFact::Absent — a PERMANENT verdict cached in PullSession::transport_shape_facts.
(2) invalidation — invalidate_transport_products (pull.rs:1286-1318) via invalidate_demand_derived_products/invalidate_edge_derived_products walks runtime_demand_dependents/demand_flow_dependents, which are populated ONLY as a side effect of runtime_demand.rs:387/412 — i.e. only after some executable's demand settle READ another's demand.
A caller Y pulled into an early incomplete closure with callee X via channel (1) (callsite summary exists; X's demand not yet settled) gets a premature Absent for its ReturnPayload and never registers as X's runtime_demand_dependent — so when X later settles and invalidates, the walk never reaches Y; the stale Absent is never retracted. Wait order steers which closure epoch answers each pull. The 826->785 position shrinkage: later closures walk the SAME channel (1) over materialized (pruned) bodies while earlier ones used full lowered bodies — different position sets per epoch, first-landed wins, no retroactive edge.

FIX DESIGN (the follow-on implementation's spec):
1. CONSULTED-FACTS LEDGER: every CallSiteSummary / RuntimeDemand.callable_flows / IncomingInputSlot read performed during one closure solve gets recorded as a dependency edge (on SolvedTransportClosure or a new TransportClosureConsult record), merged with runtime_demand_dependents/demand_flow_dependents — making the discovery graph and the invalidation graph THE SAME GRAPH by construction.
2. PROVENANCE-CARRYING ABSENCE: retire the unconditional record_absent_transport_shape_for (jobs/transport.rs:693) in favor of a value carrying its closure provenance — unknown-is-not-none needs a third state here: Shape / AbsentForClosure(closure_id) / never a terminal absent-for-all-time. A later invalidation reaching any consulted member retracts the provisional Absent.
3. Only after (1)+(2): DELETE sorted_executable_waits + its display-render key + the comment block at jobs/transport.rs:1024-1033; add a transport_contract_test.rs order-independence case driving the pull loop with HashSet-order (or permuted) waits; run the fixture matrix as the acceptance gate (the 19 trial failures must vanish with the sort gone).
4. Re-check the .28.2 Ord-on-interned-ids watch once the sort is deleted (ActivationKey/ExecutableKey Ord is per-process; sweep for interim cross-run leanings).

CROSS-TICKET CONNECTION (for .28.6): the mechanism — a fact consulted through a channel not wired into whatever invalidates it — is the same shape as the demand-cone membership variance (217 vs 225, .28.11's finding) and plausibly the ReturnType widening wobble. .28.6 should start from this mechanism, not re-derive it.

WHY NOT LANDED: unifying the graphs is a wide-blast-radius PullSession invalidation-bookkeeping change (transport.rs 4.4k lines; pull.rs invalidation walks also serve demand/effects/artifact production) — not responsibly landable+verifiable in one pass; a half-applied version is worse than the documented sort-protected status quo.

ACCEPTANCE (unchanged in spirit): suite + fixture matrix green 3x WITH sorted_executable_waits deleted; the order-independence test; no display-string keys in the flow; byte-identical fixture outputs on the deterministic set.
title: Transport plan completeness is pull-wait-order dependent (schedule-protected path dependence)
